purpose: Post-V3 external semantic corroboration for selected remaining PulseLive team-match source fields. This file records concept evidence only and does not itself expose, canonically label, aggregate or promote any field.

statsperform_opta_event_definitions.use: Primary event-definition support for cards, passes, launches, flick-ons, lay-offs, corners and blocked crosses.

statsperform_betting_event_definitions.use: Additional public Opta definitions for pass-event subtypes including chipped passes, launches, flick-ons and lay-offs.

premierleague_stats_clarification.use: Official Premier League statistical vocabulary including club red cards, substitutions, long balls, corners, goalkeeper throw-outs and goal kicks.

redCard.note: Opta explicitly collects red cards and the Premier League exposes club red-card statistics. Exact source-field aggregation remains subject to ordinary FRL source review.

subsMade.note: The Premier League exposes club substitution statistics. The source-field name is strongly consistent with a team-match substitution count, but FRL still requires source-native validation before promotion.

accurateChippedPass.note: Opta directly defines a chipped pass. The accurate subset interpretation should be supported by a zero-violation accurateChippedPass<=totalChippedPass audit.

totalLongBalls.note: Long balls are explicitly part of the Premier League statistical vocabulary. Exact team-match source aggregation still requires FRL review.

accurateLongBalls.note: The long-ball concept is official. The accurate subset interpretation should be supported by an accurateLongBalls<=totalLongBalls audit.

totalLaunches.note: Opta directly defines a Launch as a long high ball into space or an area for players to chase or challenge for the ball.

accurateLaunches.note: The Launch concept is directly defined. The accurate subset interpretation should be supported by an accurateLaunches<=totalLaunches audit.

totalFlickOn.note: Opta directly defines a Flick-On as a glancing pass with head or foot onto a teammate while helping the ball on in the same general direction.

accurateFlickOn.note: The Flick-On concept is directly defined. The accurate subset interpretation should be supported by an accurateFlickOn<=totalFlickOn audit.

totalLayoffs.note: Opta directly defines a Lay-Off as a first-time pass away from goal under pressure, typically by a forward with their back to goal.

accurateLayoffs.note: The Lay-Off concept is directly defined. The accurate subset interpretation should be supported by an accurateLayoffs<=totalLayoffs audit.

blockedCross.note: Opta explicitly describes Blocked Passes / Blocked Crosses as defensive actions when a cleanly played pass or cross is already travelling on its intended path and is blocked.

keeperThrows.note: Opta explicitly distinguishes Keeper Throws from ordinary passes and the Premier League exposes goalkeeper throw-outs. Exact source-field aggregation remains subject to FRL review.

accurateKeeperThrows.note: The goalkeeper-throw concept is directly supported; the accurate subset interpretation should be empirically checked against keeperThrows.

accurateGoalKicks.note: Goal kicks are explicitly recognised in Opta pass-event categorisation and Premier League goalkeeper statistics. The accurate outcome qualifier still requires source-level review.

accurateCross.note: Crosses and cross accuracy are official Premier League statistical concepts. The accurateCross<=totalCross relationship should be empirically verified.

wonCorners.note: Opta directly defines Corner Won as a corner awarded to the attacking team after the ball leaves play.

lostCorners.note: Opta directly defines Corner Lost as collected for the team conceding the corner. Opta also states Corner Won/Lost and Corner Taken use different collection criteria, so their aggregate totals may differ. The previously observed lostCorners-versus-opponent-cornerTaken mismatches are therefore not evidence against the Corner Lost interpretation. Historical blanks must still remain missing unless independently governed otherwise.

governance_note: External terminology is semantic corroboration only. It never substitutes for FRL source-field, relationship, missingness, aggregation, comparability or temporal review.
